description: Installations de production d'électricité renouvelable par commune au 1er janvier 2013 is a dataset listed in cc-lacqorthez-data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by ORECCA. Puissance raccordée des installations de production d'électricité renouvelable (hydraulique et solaire photovoltaïque) par commune sur la CCLO au 1er janvier 2013. Coverage: Lacq-Orthez (Pyrénées-Atlantiques). The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are Energies renouvelables, biomasse, éolien, géothermie, hydraulique, solaire. The portal shows 61 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-01-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-cc-lacqorthez-fr-portal.
